clauses.quote: DCPS shall continue to provide a minimum of nine (9) non-instructional days for professional development during the duration of this CBA, in a manner determined by DCPS, but in consultation with the WTU.

Every year, DCPS shall, in consultation with the WTU, develop and implement a professional development program and calendar for all Teachers on the most relevant issues facing Teachers including, but not limited to, the new Teaching and Learning Framework which is the basis of the new Educator Evaluation System.
The professional development program will be developed and begin implementation by September 15th of each school year.
clauses.notes: Passive construction implies management's duty to execute the program.

clauses.quote: The Parties shall jointly develop and conduct two mandatory trainings on the content of this Agreement.
Representatives of the WTU and DCPS shall conduct the trainings.
clauses.subject_text: Representatives of the WTU and DCPS

clauses.quote: The DCPS representatives may include individuals from the Office of the Chancellor, the Office of the General Counsel, Labor Management Employee Relations, and the Office of Human Resources.
DCPS shall provide written notice of potential school reform, inclusive of all options under NCLB for restructuring, to the WTU and all Teachers in the affected schools that have been identified.
